title.narrative: EQUANOMICS: Making care systems work for women’s economic empowerment in Kazakhstan

description.narrative: EQUANOMICS supports governments to reform fiscal policy so that tax and spending actively reduce gender gaps, especially in work, entrepreneurship, assets and time poverty, while strengthening gender responsive public finance and the greater investments policies that contribute to reduce the socio-economic against women. This initiative will contribute to the EQUANOMICS portfolio, providing targeted technical assistance to Kazakhstan, supporting in the expansion of care systems by increasing and making more efficient financial investments on the provision of care-related services. The initiative will help to: (1) Mobilize and align public finance with the expansion and consolidation of care systems; (2) Generate evidence, data, and pilot innovations to inform scalable care system policies; (3) Strengthen national policy frameworks and institutional capacities to design, implement, and monitor inclusive, gender-transformative, and disability-inclusive care systems.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
